title: OSS Document Scanner: free CamScanner alternative
caption:
CamScanner charges $49.99/year to scan your documents. OSS Document Scanner does it for free 📄

✅ Scan with the camera, automatic edge detection, batch mode
✅ Crop, rotate, enhance, merge, then export PDF, JPEG or PNG
✅ Offline OCR for searchable PDFs, plus optional PDF password
✅ No subscription, no watermark, 100% free

📱 iPhone · Android
ℹ️ The iPhone app has optional tip-jar purchases (a coffee), and OCR language models are downloaded the first time you use them. CamScanner Premium is about $49.99/year, up to $59.99/year on other plans

Comment "SCANNER" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
